text:
Alex (Growth): Quick sync — we need final copy for three landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), a short launch post, plus a webinar that gates the full benchmark kit. Goal = capture mode intent and route leads properly.
Jules (PMM): Core narrative idea: 'Serving economics, simplified.' Lead with the problem (surprise latency & cost drift) then map to the mode promise. Keep language engineer-friendly, not salesy.
Marta (Content): Proposed hero drafts: Hosted: "Get production-quality inference in minutes." Dedicated: "Capacity you can commit to." Private: "Isolate inference inside your network." Subheads: one sentence each with the primary signal (latency / predictability / compliance).
Theo (Design): Will make three hero comps and a small benchmark teaser module. Avoid raw numbers on the public page; we'll show a one-line stat like "verified profiles" and ask people to register for the kit.
Raj (Sales Ops): Routing rules: Hosted CTAs -> product activation sequence; Dedicated CTAs -> AE queue Enterprise-Res; Private CTAs -> AE + security intake. We should tag contacts with `mode_interest` and `tokens_monthly_bucket`.
Alex (Growth): Can we add a tiny interactive on the webinar reg to capture monthly token ranges? That'll help prioritize AE outreach.
Marta (Content): Yes — suggested buckets: <10M, 10-100M, 100M-1B, 1B+. Also add primary_use_case dropdown (chat, search, agent, embedding).
ops-bot: Note: publishing webinar page will auto-create HubSpot campaign id: serve-econ-launch-2026 and add utm_campaign=serve_econ_launch to CTAs.
Raj (Sales Ops): For tracking fallback, add `mode_hint` to CTA links, e.g.:
```
https://redwood.com/demo?mode_hint=dedicated&utm_campaign=serve_econ_launch
```
If the form is skipped, we can route based on mode_hint. QA needs to confirm parameter is captured.
Theo (Design): I'll stamp CTA components with data-cta-id and include hidden input wiring for mode_hint. Upload comps by 3pm.
Marta (Content): Microcopy under buttons: Hosted: "Start free — no card"; Dedicated: "Reserve capacity — speak to an AE"; Private: "Request private eval — security first". Add a 1-line KMS note on Private page: "Supports customer-managed keys."
Jules (PMM): Webinar outline: 5m framing, 12m runtime demo, 10m benchmark deep-dive (methodology), 18m mode-specific Q&A (dedicated/private), 15m open Q&A. Promote the benchmark kit as post-webinar gated download.
Alex (Growth): A/B test: Hero headline A vs B across Hosted + Dedicated (speed-first vs economics-first) for 14 days. Primary metric = demo clicks / signups; secondary = time-on-page. We'll use incremental rolling holdout to reduce launch noise.
Raj (Sales Ops): SLA: AE follow-up within 24 hours for Dedicated/Private registrants flagged with tokens >10M. Hosted signups go to automated onboarding. I'll draft HubSpot workflows after copy freeze.
Marta (Content): Draft launch post structure: 1) the problem in <150 words, 2) three mode summaries, 3) two benchmark teases, 4) webinar CTA + gated kit. Include a tweet-length blurb for socials. I'll drop copy by EOD.
Theo (Design): One ask: keep hero verbs consistent (Start / Reserve / Request) so the A/B data is cleaner. Also we'll show an abstract latency curve for Hosted vs Dedicated (no scales).
ops-bot: Reminder: add form fields: mode_interest, monthly_tokens_bucket, primary_use_case. Publish will create campaign 'serve-econ-launch-2026'.
Alex (Growth): Timeline: copy freeze tomorrow 9am PT, design comps by 3pm, QA by Wednesday, soft launch Thursday. After freeze I'll post the routing matrix and AE queue mapping here. Last call for edits. :white_check_mark:
